signature: SUBROUTINE DLAMRG( N1, N2, A, DTRD1, DTRD2, INDEX )

params.name: n2
params.reference: These arguments contain the respective lengths of the two sorted lists to be merged.

params.name: a
params.reference: The first `N1` elements of A contain a list of numbers which are sorted in either ascending or descending order. Likewise for the final `N2` elements.

params.name: dtrd2
params.reference: These are the strides to be taken through the array A. Allowable strides are 1 and -1. They indicate whether a subset of A is sorted in ascending (DTRDx = 1) or descending (DTRDx = -1) order.

params.name: INDEX
params.reference: On exit this array will contain a permutation such that if $B( I ) = A( \mathrm{INDEX}( I ) )$ for $I=1$,`N1`+`N2`, then B will be sorted in ascending order.
